name: co-VC Dimension / Hitting Size (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal C^{\cap}_n=\{\{0,i\}:1\leq i\leq n\}$, $\mathrm{coVC}=n$ after projecting away the common coordinate, whereas $\mathrm{HT}=1$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, $\mathrm{HT}=n$ because every singleton must be hit, whereas $\mathrm{coVC}=0$ because every trace is realized.
proof: The two explicit families give unbounded gaps in the two opposite directions.
references: Database-owned value proofs for Common-Core Singletons and the Full Cube.
